Test Case Title: Generate and download a text file with the text "Hello from Selenium" and check its name and content.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Download Files' page of the practice site; the browser downloads into an empty temporary folder
Test Steps: 1. Type the text in the text area. 2. Click the button that generates the text file. 3. Wait for the download. 4. Read the file.
Expected Result: The file "info.txt" is downloaded and holds "Hello from Selenium".

Test Case Title: Generate and download a PDF file with the text "PDF content" and check its name and content.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Download Files' page of the practice site; the browser downloads into an empty temporary folder
Test Steps: 1. Type the text in the text area. 2. Click the button that generates the PDF file. 3. Wait for the download. 4. Read the file bytes.
Expected Result: The file "info.pdf" is downloaded and its bytes are exactly "PDF content" (site quirk: not a real PDF).
